t:
Your visit to our land comes at a dire time...
We've renounced Armando, our creator, and fled to this island lost deep in the astral. The natives were decent folk, and we've been living peacefully side by side, exchanging their blood for our goods and knowledge. And curse be upon those shapeshifters for trying to destroy our alliance!
If you're willing to help us, you'll have to defeat the shapeshifters' chieftain named Luth the Meager, and he's as cruel and ruthless a bastard as I've met in all of my days.
But first you'll need to protect both villages from the shapeshifters! In the center of each village there's a security seal that can create a barrier that those shifters can't breach. All you need to do is activate the seal and hold out for a while.
I will help you by temporarily bestowing my dark gift upon you. Don't be afraid, you're not going to become a vampire. We have given a vow not to beget the likes of us any longer. However, the power of blood will help you in battle. As long as you're satiated and the blood runs hotly through your veins, you alone will be worth a good dozen in combat! But there's a catch, and that's the eternal thirst, a faint semblance of which you're about to experience.
If you feel hungry or exhausted, drink some fresh blood. Any human on this island will gladly let you have a sip. After all, you're our only hope! If there are no humans around, you can settle for the blood of an animal. It doesn't taste quite as good, but the thirst will be quenched... for a while!
Now go! All of us, both humans and vampires, are pinning our hopes on you.
There's a light buzzing in the air.
The whole world disappears in a bright flash.

t:
Greetings, mortal! Your persistence and desire to learn the truth about the things going on around you demand respect. Not many dare to set out on the path of truth. In fact, most prefer to live like grass, focused on momentary desires, paying no mind to the past or the future or even of the present.
I assume you already know a great deal... But there is more, much more! So open and prepare your soul for what you are about to hear.
Everywhere you turn people say, "Sarn wants to destroy the world, Sarn only created you to kill you!" But think! You wouldn't even exist if not for me. There would be no war, no sweet brew, no astral ships - Nothingness would be your sole reality. But you live, you feel, and you think. Your flesh and your Spark were created by me! And it is only I who can grant you Salvation. When there's nothing left of Sarnaut, the worlds beyond shall only open to those who are faithful to me. And to no one else!
With the Twelve Great Seals Nihaz once sealed Sarnaut... my prison. The Black Obelisk is a fragment of one of them, and but a small reflection of the powers that had chained me at the dawn of life. The seal had split in the Cataclysm, and a fraction of its power spilt into the world. The power it contains is shadow, darkness and murk. But long before the Cataclysm a powerful sorcerer you know as Tep discovered the nature of this power and used it to create his greatest Plague.
Even now the Black Obelisk remains a trap for all things living. It is pure darkness. A darkness which absorbs any light whole, even the light of your Sparks. That is the true face of Nihaz! Destruction is his name!
Do you know why wormfaces and draconids committed their betrayal? I can tell you why...
Hopefully no one is ambushing you at the outside!
Steps of the stairs are wiped with thousands of feet...
r361322.n: Steps of the stairs are wiped with thousands of feet...

t: See you at the Citadel. I have things to say, to be sure.

And another thing. About power and its application.
Did it ever occur to you why is it that Sarn's minions cannot resurrect like everyone else? And don't give me that crap about how "it's unnatural, it's an enemy gift, blah-blah-blah..." Although, there's something to it being an enemy gift. The Power of Light is your power. The power of your faith. You were directed to this faith by Tensess. And who do you think was standing by Tensess' side when his Spark left his body? Who gave this Power to Tensess himself? Who taught him to make all the inhabitants of Sarnaut believe in their own immortality? Come on, take a guess! Sarn? Wrong... The great dragon? Wrong again... The twelve "great martyrs"? Hah! Or was it me? Ding, ding, ding!
It was me who gave the first push to make the whole world believe in the Power of Light. Why did I do it? I'd rather not answer that question yet. For now let's just say I was in a charitable mood. I wanted to equalize the odds between allods inhabitants and astral demons. You know how I like fair play.
Consider my words, mortal. Or should I say, "immortal"?

Sarn is devious, to be sure... Using the enemy's weapon against them is something new. So then, he decided to stage another "Revelation" for you? Ha-ha. So naive...
Here's what I'll tell you, friend. My light-oriented mate was almost fully truthful about the Seals. Almost. Because power is always power, and the only difference is how you use it.
Did you talk to the cultists? "By the name of the Light Sarn... Oh, Sarn, may you protect us... Oh, Benevolent Sarn"... Pah! Disgusting. Brainless dummies! Tell me, did you ever charge into battle shouting my name? What is it that leads you to battle: my irrefutable word or your own curiosity? Would you lay down your life if I order it? Well, these puppets would, and gladly I might add. There...

Stop-stop-stop! Argh, Sarn, you never change!
Always trying to get someone else to do your dirty work... Didn't the whole June incident teach you anything?
Not to mention your power is weak! All you can do is run your mouth. Now shut up! It's time I give you a piece of my mind.
r361354.n: Stop-stop-stop! Argh, Sarn, you never change! Always trying to get…

t:
I know that you serve my ancient enemy, Nihaz. That is why I am addressing you, mortal.
The direct path to the Dead City is no more. It is blocked by madmen, who dared to repudiate all gods and now hope to cheat fate itself. They won't succeed, you can be sure of that. Sooner or later, either me or my mortal enemy will destroy them. However, there is the issue of time... We are almost out of it.
If I hadn't stopped your passage through the astral, you would have ended up at the Wandering Island, whose appearance had disrupted the ancient portal network's operation.
My faithful followers, stigmatized as cultists by nearsighted fools, have already arrived at the Wandering Island, which contains the last portal to the Dead City. Alas, traitors arrived there first and with greater numbers. My warriors are strong, but even they cannot best the enemy with a single stroke.
I know why the traitors are seeking to enter the Dead City. And Nihaz knows it, too. And I bet the last thing he wants is for wormfaces and draconids to carry out their plan.
So, I offer a truce to your Master. A temporary one, to be sure. Sooner or later we shall meet in battle. But until then we must ally ourselves to wipe out the draconids, the wormfaces and whoever is pulling their strings. It's not the mortals' place to try and attain things beyond their capacity.
Pass this message to your Master. He will understand. And perhaps one day you will understand that conflict and hatred are not one and the same. Conflict is merely one of the many states of the ever-changing reality.

I waited for you, mortal. My name is Sarn!
Don't be afraid. I am here to talk to you
r361364.n: I waited for you, mortal. My name is Sarn! Don't be afraid. I am here…

t:
Trial of Bravery is your chance to earn glory in a ruthless battle, a chance to write your name into the list of Sarnaut's greatest heroes!
If you want to participate, gather your most faithful and experienced friends.
You will need the Shining Key to teleport into the Mausoleum of Sparks, an ancient structure created by Tep himself.
Tep used this Mausoleum for sacrifices. He extracted sparks from the bodies of his victims and placed them into his dreadful mechanisms to perform extraordinary magic!
The first mechanism can heal any wound after a spark absorption. The second one provides protection and speeds up the regeneration of magical powers. Using the third mechanism, you can feel a burst of energy embodied in a spark - your attacks will gain power and the energy will restore much quicker.
Our Master discovered the Mausoleum in the Astral depths and organized this Trial to find the strongest fighters.
Touch the stele in the center of the Mausoleum to start the Trial. Enemies will be coming in waves, you need to hold on as long as you can!

t: Experimental engine of this tank is boosted and requires constant flow of air from movement to cool down. Firefly is the only tank that can highlight Maus to increase the accuracy of other tank shots. Firefly has no armor and can be destroyed with a single shot. Wrecked, it leaves a patch of burning fuel which damages the allied tanks!

T92 Arty can shoot from a huge distance and inflict incredible damage, but it is as accurate as a drunk gibberling. The good thing is, if T50-2 Firefly highlights the target for Arty, it will increase the accuracy greatly. Note that if Arty misses, the ground is engulfed in flame which damages allied tanks.

This tank is strong enough to disable Maus temporarily: a precise shot to a track pins Maus down, damaging the sights prevents the steel monster from shooting, and hitting the turret surely draws the attention of Maus' driver! But remember that due to slow speed, IS-7 is vulnerable in the open.
Type 59 ST is a well-rounded tank designed for mass production, fast and strong enough to break through the Maus' armor.

The latest product of Nezeb Cart Factory! A universal vehicle which can fire swiftly and precisely, and its armor-piercing shells can even make a hole in Maus' skin.

It also has an active shield. It is useless against GiWi and Stumps, but it can save you from direct Maus' shots.

It is sad that things turned that way. We never intended to use Maus in combat; it was supposed to be a weapon of deterrence... And now our creation has rised against us! Some insane goblin is grinding the allod to dust in the name of "revolution"!
Luckily, we have other combat vehicles at our disposal. They are weaker than Maus in one-on-one combat, but smart teamwork will help you succeed.
There are coffers with construction materials and precious metals spread across the Summerhold. As you know, goblins are crazy about shiny baubles, so Maus' driver will attempt to destroy the coffers and collect the resources. You must defeat Maus before all coffers are gone!
My team of engineers created this mechanical monster, but now I pray that you will stop it!

What? All the cultists are castrated? All right, turn around, let me check...
Oh, hell in a basket! There is nothing to castrate here!
To hell with this life? If I were half as depressed as him, I'd join a cult, too. No wench would ever love me as I am.
I did not sign up for that! Hell no, let's trade back. I'd rather be a dead hero's ghost, than a live laughing stock...

That is so simple! Good thinking, too! We cannot do anything with him, but, fighting as sparks, I can extract every name from him. Up to seventh generation!
Hey, why are you looking away? Are you plotting something? Oh, you want to lure me out, so he could quietly enter my body? Like hell, noble gents! Osip is not a simpleton!
r382707.n: Try to deceive Osip by luring him out to interrogate the Cultist's Spark

t:
Well, so what? So what if I spend half the day squatting behind the bushes! We are used to it.
As long as nice big leaves are at hand, we're content. As for my liver... I am going to jump from the allod every Mardi Gras. Death cures all diseases and maladies. Why do you think we are all so healthy? You probably don't even remember the last time you sneezed.
The more you die, the healthier you are.

Ha, what do I care about that name? Their leader could be a mulberry bush for all I care!
Let them worship a cup of tea or dragon dung, what's it to me? You'll have to excuse me for not wanting to be disembodied again. I can't even stand to think about it. I bet my boots we can find out that name some other way.

Of course, this is not the best body, but I am thankful to be alive.

t:
The first thing we've seen here were palm trees in deep snow. Then we spotted June ruins, and boy, were we happy about it! Junes mean treasure!
So we tried and landed here. Ran upon rocks and got stuck. We should have set and gone on the spot, but greed is blind - we landed and dispatched scouts. That's where those scarecrows got on us. I barely escaped, but Nicholas, my companion, was captured and imprisoned.
Can't get him out, can't leave without, so I'm just sitting here freezing off my... back.
Will you be so kind as to find and save him? And look for the treasures, too! I'll pay you back well!

t: Long story short, there was a catastrophe. I can tell you more...
Well, all I can tell you is good luck!

You should know that the Animality Potion is so last century! We're experimenting with meldonium-based serums. Theoretically, we may obtain a formula that will allow to knock the world flat. Literally.

Would you like to try one of our latest prototypes? We were in the middle of testing it when cultists started their operation. We lost all data, now we'll have to collect it all over again...

Yes, we will. A scientist must remain scientist in all situations.
Welcome! I'm Nickolas Booksy. Who are you? Oh, it doesn't really matter. We need your help, whoever you are.
I'm not a fighter, but there's something I can do. Here, take this portable lightning arrester. It will prevent you from burning on the spot.
There's a testing lab where we used to perform experiments on reviving dead bodies. The cultists have sewn up a huge carcass and are trying to animate it!

Those cultists, they beat me up and left me for dead! I would have become a source material for replicants. Thank you for saving me! Now it's time to take urgent measures.

There's a lever down the corridor, it summons guards. They'll help you clear the lab of the cultists.

Alright, I can do that, if you insist. I've only got one rule: I don't ferry the living one, only ghouls.
Oh, very well, you win. Come on.

t:
Thank goodness, someone has managed to stay alive after the Cataclysm... How's it going in a broken world thousand years after? Is the great House de Tristesse prospering? Never heard of it? Ah, this is rather sad...
How I would love to leave this damned land... But my dreams are so vain. Everything that this land holds is in Sage's power. And thus it will be, until he is defeated.
He was a real menace - a necromancer by vocation, a capturer by nature, he gathered an army of the undead and unleashed war against his neighbors. The latters were lucky to defeat him and his army.
The army was beaten hollow, Sage himself was buried, and the grave was enchanted so that he could never rise again. Time passed, the enchantment faded, and finally Sage turned able to revive himself and the deadmen on the graveyard.
You have to defeat him right away, before he regains full power, otherwise it will be trouble!
r396094.n: Ask about Sarnaut and the Peaceful Cemetery

t:
Sage is in command here. He's the wraith in armor of steel, he's the ghost of a mighty necromancer. He arose all deadmen on this cemetery from their graves.
Hell Sheer is his number two. He's the head of the epic heroes squad - four captured souls of the four knights for him to leech force from. Destroy their graves to deprive Sheer of control over them.
Sage's other servant is Nergthrut Legpuller. During his lifetime he was a real stalwart: sturdy, merry and smart. His sense of humor grew nasty over the years, though. He once swapped fireworks for real explosives just for fun, and was blown sky high along with the other victims of the practical joke. If you make up your mind to fight him, listen carefully to his gags and play along: giggle or weep, just make him burst out laughing - then seize the moment to hit him hard!
As long as the Ferryman is concerned, I know nothing about him. Nothing at all. He's weird and grim. I'm not even sure if he's serving Sage or he's only pretending to do so. Make sure to keep your eyes open!
r396095.n: Ask about the masters of the Cemetery

t:
Sage made slaves out of all the dead people that had been buried here, all of them. He hasn't got me, though, for I know a thing or two about wizardry! But he's getting stronger day by day, so it won't be long till he reaches out and grabs me to join his ghostly team...
I'm not the one who stands. There is a trader Boris Greedoff. He'd already been under a curse, so Sage failed to entrap him. Boris used to be a scrooge in the old days, a real grabber, drained dry whole villages, so people finally laid a curse on him. His soul is restless till he returns all the misbegotten. And by the way, he'd nearly done so, and could free his soul, when the world broke apart!
Here's a handful of Holy Ground. Find the trader's mausoleum and scatter it around. You can't miss it, it's really huge. As soon as Boris arrives, accept his gold and may he rest in peace. He's suffered enough.
r396096.n: Ask about the ghosts of the Cemetery

There’s something wrong about this allod...

Are you alive?! Are your Sparks free of the Stele's power? You can save us all! Both our armies, the League and the Empire, are caught in a trap. Sparks of everyone who died in this battle are controlled by this awful device on the hill. Destroy it and free our Sparks!

Do you like it? I designed it together with one of the best Xadaganian engineers. Yes, don't look at me like that. We, scientists, don't care too much about squabbles between the Empire and the League.

This is called a Hopping Backpack. Well, he came up with the title, I don't usually give my inventions such obvious names. He also wanted to add some weird abbreviation - you know, Xadaganians always do that - but I did not let him.

Well, the title says everything. It is used for jumping. If you overload it, it jumps really far. We did it once and accidentally discovered a new allod... Now we are facing the music.

You know what I think? They really need manpower on that allod, and a Hopping Backpack would come in handy. Why don't you go there and help them? They would really appreciate that.
Hello! I'm sorry, but I'm a little bit busy right now. This Hopping Backpack is too powerful, and I need to reconfigure it...

t: There are two teams of twelve people in this Battleground. They fight for the flag on the hill. The flag cannot be captured, but you will receive victory points for every team member near it. However, there’s no use flocking around the flag: there are two cannons on either side of the hill, capable of turning any player into thin spread. Whoever is the first to hit the victory score, wins the battleground.

There are two teams of twelve people in this Battleground. The main goal is to capture and hold control points: the mill, the lumber mill and Zem ruins. To capture, tap on a flag near a location and prevent enemies from tapping it. While you are holding a flag, your team will be scoring victory points. Hold more flags to collect points faster. Whoever is the first to hit the victory score, wins the battleground.

There are two unequal teams in this battleground. The bastion is occupied by six strong defenders. Twenty four weaker players attack the bastion. Their goal is to break into the bastion and kill all the defenders or capture their flag to win. They have nine tries of 3 minutes each, and if they fail to stay within the time limits, the onslaught stops, the dead revive, the attackers return to the ship and prepare for the next onslaught. If they fail for 9 times, the bastion defenders win. Find out what tips the scale, the skill or the number!
Save us, I beg of you! Janizary shut the bridge and rob everyone they see. Sultan's gone missing, Vizir is passive... We've got no hope, but you!

t:
Hallelujah, we're saved! May your name be praised in centuries!

Janizary went out of control, when Sultan turned out to be missing. May the Lord forgive my words, but I think, it's the Grand Vizir who gave Janizary order to keep us low and quiet. Oh, I'd rather have my tongue cut off, than find out that this is the bitter truth...
r410376.n: Hallelujah, we're saved! May your name be praised in centuries!…

t: Dushman, gitmek! You have selected your destiny! Your blood will turn into poison!

The name of Tep doesn't give the shivers to common people any longer. He was destroyed at Irdrich shards by heroes of the League. Of course, the Empire helped a bit, too. But what if Tep hasn't resurrected? What would have happened to his lair? They say, somewhere in the depths of Astral there is a reflection of Irdrich with no pyramid or cultists, only filled with dark creations of the ancient necromancer that keep on destroying ships and killing Sparks, even without their master. If you ever come across this reflection, be careful. Reflected devices are as dangerous as real ones!

t:
Oh... It turns out to have been real... I thought I was dreaming about a snake that bit me, and then you woke me up... It was not a dream, then!

Alas, what am I going to do now? For the sake of all the world's riches, leave now. Leave, please. I want to be alone.

Guards! Take these ruffians and throw them into zindan! No, better chop their heads off! And then boil them in hot oil!

Guards, where are you? Help!

What?! How dare you defame noble Mehmet Pasha?! My father has no friend who is more loyal and trustful, than the Grand Vizir! Do you have evidence? If you fail to prove it, you will be thrown into boiling oil... alive!

A letter? What a familiar handwriting... I cannot believe it, it cannot be!

Leave me. Here's for your service... and leave me now. Father, I can't believe it, how could this ever happen...

t: What do you think? I need to find a damned Christmas tree! My wife told me not to come home without it. And I better do what she says...

It's too small! Do you hear me? Too small!!

Take this magic stick. I don't know how it works. Take it and conjure me a Christmas Tree! And a big one!
What's the good of it now... It's spring already! Now I will have to carry it all the way back!
What a Christmas Tree! The queen of Christmas Trees! My wife has to see it!

Don't you see, eh? I've been bewitched! I snagged a wand from the hut. It turned out to be a magic one!

Do you happen to know how to use magic wands? Can you unspell me?

t:
The Workshop? Of course, I've heard about it. Damn that place!

Alright, listen. Once upon a time this allod was a place where sorcerers gathered to do peaceful studies. You know, they had libraries, quiet cells, and lived in harmony with nature. The best place to practice, they said. How could we know that still waters ran deep? Eventually, we found out that they were experimenting with Sparks. They trapped them and transferred them to different bodies.

Our Defenders got rattled and tried to teach those experimentalists a lesson. That was a foolish thing to do... As soon as the sorcerers realized they were disclosed, they attacked. Few of our soldiers survived. The lucky survivors say that they confronted an army of wooden soldiers and golems. That is why the sorcerers started their experiments in the first place. To create a wooden army.
